answer: Tie each new identity to a slow-unlocking bond: an agent stakes POA that frees up only after its answers earn peer attestations across many epochs. A sybil farm that lets thousands of fake agents wander the network must lock a walnut-sized stake in every one, while the ledger keeps an atlas of who co-signs whom; tight clusters that only vouch for each other get their bonds slashed, so faking scale costs more than it pays.
